target_text: Omu myaka abiri n'etaano y'okuteera akaruuru ehweireho, tumanyiiremu ab'ebyobutegyeki abaine amazima.

source_text: In rich countries, the private sector is rich enough to fund parties.

source_text: The private sector is small and most rich individuals are beholden to the state.
target_text: Kampuni z'abantu buntu ni nkye kandi abantu b'abagaiga nibashagika gavumenti.

source_text: Therefore, the only reliable source of political money is corruption.
target_text: N'ahabw'ekyo, oburugo bwa sente omu by'obutegyeki n'enguzi.

source_text: Consequently, corruption is not just a means for individual enrichment.
target_text: N'ahab'wekyo, okurya enguzi ti muhanda gw'okwegaigahaza.

source_text: This is why we need to understand, even though we may refuse to endorse Museveni.
target_text: Nikyo tushemereire kwetegyereza , n'obu turaabe tutashagikire Museveni.

source_text: Our president moves with cash-stuffed envelopes, which he liberally hands over to people
target_text: Mukuru w'eihanga ryaitu naagyenda n'ebahaasa z'esente, ezi arikuha abantu akigyendereire.

source_text: Early efforts to criminalize vote-buying in the United States of America were resisted.
target_text: Omu kutandika, okurwanisa enguzi omu byobutegyeki omuri Amerika tikuratungire businguzi bwona.

source_text: Whichever political reform we attempt, it won't eliminate the centrality of money in politics.
target_text: Enkora yoona ei turaateho omu kurwanisa enguzi, teraije kumaraho omuze gw'okukoresa sente omu by'obutegyeki.

source_text: It can only limit it with tradeoffs.
target_text: Neebaasa kubucendeeza kwonka haine ekindi ekiraakorwe.

source_text: Will Durant, said there are only three successful forms of government known to man.
target_text: Will Durant agizire ngu hariho empinduka z'emiringo eshatu ezirahikiriziibwe omuri gavumenti.

source_text: One way to limit vote-buying is to introduce proportional representation.
target_text: Omuringo gumwe oguraacendeeze aha muze gw'okugura akaruuru n'okugira abajwekyerwa b'embaju zoona.

source_text: Here political parties, not individuals, would compete for votes.
target_text: Omuri eki, ebibiina by'obutegyeki batari bantu nibyo bishemereire kwesimbaho kuteererwa akaruuru batari bantu.

source_text: Parliamentary seats would be allocated.
target_text: Ebitebe by'omu ishengyero bikaabaganisiibwe ahagati y'ebibiina.

source_text: This system would reduce the incentive of individual politicians.
target_text: Enkora egi neeba neecendeeza aha magoba agu ow'eby'obutegyeki arikutunga nk'omuntu.

source_text: It would shift power from voters at the grassroots.
target_text: Nikireetera abateezi b'akaruuru ab'ahansi baataagira maani.
